release_date.note: HF dataset repo creation date, not the builder's own release announcement.

content.value: Technical report: 'roughly one million prompt-response pairs using the GPT-3.5-Turbo OpenAI API between March 20, 2023 and March 26th, 2023', prompts drawn from LAION OIG (unified chip2), Stack Overflow questions, and Bigscience/P3; P3 was later dropped, leaving a final subset of 437,605 prompt-generation pairs used to train the first release.
content.note: Conflicting third-party statement: the StableLM-Tuned-Alpha card describes GPT4All Prompt Generations as '400k prompts and responses generated by GPT-4' (https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stablelm-tuned-alpha-7b). The builder's own report says GPT-3.5-Turbo throughout; the builder's wording is kept, and the edge below rests on it.
